## Checklist

- [ ] One concern, not several.
- [ ] Commit subjects are lowercase, with an area prefix where one fits (`docs:`, `ci:`).
- [ ] No credentials, tokens or real subscription URLs anywhere in the diff.
- [ ] Wrapping matches the file being edited, so the diff shows only what changed.
- [ ] No link to a private repository — those are 404 for everyone outside the organisation.
